summary: QWA309 base-board definitions (board/qwa309.h: pins, SAR map, header UART, I2C addresses) + compile-time board-scope gate; SW4/SW5 run-time pull-ups in ai-kit-board's board.c
hw_settings: QWA309 CS select switch = ON (enables the base-board I2C; else buttons/CapSense are dead)
DVP camera unplugged, or CAM ON/OFF = ON (an unpowered camera, CAM OFF, clamps P17.5/P17.7 low -> SW5/SW6 read pressed; with CAM ON SW5 works, SW6/P17.7 still reads low)
verified: 2026-10-10 tesaiot, app qwa309-buttons (pin watch): silkscreen SW5 = P17.5 active low, works with CAM ON (press also resets the DVP camera - shared RESET net); SW6/P17.7 reads 0 constantly with the camera powered; QWA309 push buttons SW1/SW2 and DIP SW3/SW4 change no MCU GPIO (CS select ON or OFF)
notes: brought in automatically by board tesaiot (BOARD_COMPONENTS); P17.5 is also the USB-host VBUS enable
